Create apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-solfege/epic.md using the template from .oneticket/templates/epic.md. Title: 'Epic 1 — Solfège Bilingual Score Cards'. Goal: Add solfège learning through bilingual (FR/EN) flashcards where the question is a music score rendered as SVG and the answer plays notes in the browser. Business Value: Enable music students to learn note recognition visually and auditorily with bilingual support. Scope: bilingual card deck (do/ré/mi vs C/D/E), score rendering on card front (VexFlow SVG), audio playback on card flip (Tone.js), 'Solfège' theme selectable from home screen. Add Related User Stories section with placeholder comments per template. Add Related Slices section with placeholder comments per template. Include title: frontmatter.

Create 4 user story files in apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-1-solfege/user-stories/ using template from .oneticket/templates/us.md. Each must have title: frontmatter.

us-005-solfege-theme.md: 'US-005 — Solfège Theme Selection'. Story: As a music learner, I want to select the Solfège theme so that I can practice note recognition. Expected: Home screen theme picker includes 'Solfège' option alongside 'World Capitals'. Selecting it loads solfège card deck. Acceptance: Solfège appears in theme picker, selection loads correct deck, existing themes unaffected.

us-006-solfege-score-render.md: 'US-006 — Score Rendering on Card Front'. Story: As a music learner, I want to see a music score on the card front so that I can identify the note visually. Expected: Card front renders a VexFlow SVG showing a single note on a treble clef staff. The note position corresponds to the question (e.g., C4 = first ledger line below staff). Acceptance: renderScore({clef, notes}) renders valid SVG in DOM, treble clef displayed, note position matches pitch.

us-007-solfege-audio-playback.md: 'US-007 — Audio Playback on Card Flip'. Story: As a music learner, I want to hear the note played when I flip the card so that I can verify my answer auditorily. Expected: On card flip, playScore({clef, notes}) plays the note sequentially using Tone.js + Web Audio API. No file download required. Acceptance: playScore plays notes in browser, triggered on card flip, sequential playback.

us-008-solfege-bilingual-names.md: 'US-008 — Bilingual FR/EN Note Names'. Story: As a bilingual music learner, I want to see both French (do/ré/mi) and English (C/D/E) note names so that I can learn in my preferred language. Expected: Card back shows both FR and EN note names. FR/EN mapping: do→C, ré→D, mi→E, fa→F, sol→G, la→A, si→B. Supports whole/half/quarter note durations. Acceptance: Both languages displayed, correct mapping, durations supported.

Each US must have Related Epic pointing to epic-1-solfege/epic.md (filename only, no path). Each US must have Related Slices section with placeholder comment per template.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-4-vexflow-render/slice.md using template from .oneticket/templates/slice.md. Title: 'Slice 4 — VexFlow Score Rendering'. Goal: Integrate VexFlow to render music scores as SVG on flashcard fronts. Context: Epic epic-1-solfege, US-006. Files: src/modules/renderScore.ts (pure function taking ScoreData, returning SVG string), src/components/ScoreCard.tsx (wrapper component injecting SVG into DOM target), package.json (add vexflow dependency). Implementation: Install vexflow, create renderScore module accepting {clef, notes}, render treble clef staff with note positions, inject SVG into target DOM element. Verification: renderScore({clef:'treble', notes:[{note:'C4',duration:'q'}]}) renders valid SVG with note on first ledger line below staff. Related Epics: epic-1-solfege/epic.md (filename only). Related User Stories: us-006-solfege-score-render.md (filename only). Include title: frontmatter.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-5-tonejs-playback/slice.md using template from .oneticket/templates/slice.md. Title: 'Slice 5 — Tone.js Audio Playback'. Goal: Integrate Tone.js to play notes in browser on card flip. Context: Epic epic-1-solfege, US-007. Files: src/modules/playScore.ts (pure function taking ScoreData, playing notes sequentially via Tone.js), src/hooks/useAudioPlayback.ts (manages Tone.js context lifecycle, play/stop controls), package.json (add tone dependency). Implementation: Install tone, create playScore module mapping note names (C4, D4...) to Tone.js frequencies, play notes sequentially respecting duration values, initialize Tone.js context on user gesture (card flip). Verification: playScore({clef:'treble', notes:[{note:'C4',duration:'q'},{note:'D4',duration:'q'}]}) plays C4 then D4 in browser. Related Epics: epic-1-solfege/epic.md (filename only). Related User Stories: us-007-solfege-audio-playback.md (filename only). Include title: frontmatter.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-6-solfege-data/slice.md using template from .oneticket/templates/slice.md. Title: 'Slice 6 — Solfège Card Data'. Goal: Create solfège theme data with bilingual FR/EN note names and varied durations. Context: Epic epic-1-solfege, US-005, US-008. Files: src/data/themes/solfege.json (theme data with cards containing FR/EN names, note pitches, durations), src/types/index.ts (add ScoreNote and ScoreData types if not present). Verification: Theme loads correctly, all 7 notes present, FR/EN mapping correct, durations valid. Related Epics: epic-1-solfege/epic.md (filename only). Related User Stories: us-005-solfege-theme.md, us-008-solfege-bilingual-names.md (filename only). Include title: frontmatter.

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-7-scorecard-ui/slice.md using template from .oneticket/templates/slice.md. Title: 'Slice 7 — ScoreCard UI Integration'. Goal: Wire ScoreCard component into SessionScreen for solfège theme. Context: Epic epic-1-solfege, US-005, US-006, US-007, US-008. Files: src/components/ScoreCard.tsx (integrates renderScore + playScore), src/screens/SessionScreen.tsx (conditional rendering: text cards vs score cards based on theme), src/hooks/useTheme.ts (extend to detect solfège theme type). Implementation: Extend SessionScreen to detect solfège theme, render ScoreCard instead of FlashcardDisplay for solfège cards, call renderScore on card front render, call playScore on card flip, ensure existing themes still use FlashcardDisplay. Verification: Solfège theme shows score cards with SVG + audio, World Capitals shows text cards with flip animation, both themes work independently. Related Epics: epic-1-solfege/epic.md (filename only). Related User Stories: us-005-solfege-theme.md, us-006-solfege-score-render.md, us-007-solfege-audio-playback.md, us-008-solfege-bilingual-names.md (filename only). Include title: frontmatter.
